svg.title: Where each model found the root-cause line, by log length and position
svg.desc: One panel per model. Rows are log lengths from 10k to 200k tokens, columns are where the root cause sits, from the first line (0%) to just before the outage (100%). Each cell counts the logs where the model gave the exact line. Totals: gpt-oss-120b: 33 of 60; DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731: 75 of 75; GLM-5.3 Flash: 75 of 75; Ministral 3 14B: 41 of 60; NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL: 44 of 45; DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813: 49 of 50.
svg.text: ROOT-CAUSE LINE FOUND, BY LOG LENGTH AND POSITION
Each cell: logs where the model gave the exact line, out of 3 different logs (2 for DeepSeek V4 Pro).
Columns: position of the cause, from the first line (0%) to just before the outage (100%). Grey: longer than the model accepts.
